description: A coin’s price, market cap, liquidity, volume, holders and last 10 trades, by coin or treasury address. terms says how it was launched (bootr, clanker for Clanker v4, clanker-v5), what it trades against (WETH, or ETH or USDC on Clanker v5) and, on Clanker v5 coins, the buy and sell tax in percent the creator set.
